_doc: The strings the run Shop screen (S08) shows, and nothing else. It exists because X-04 requires every user-facing string to be a loc key in EN and DE from day one, and because ContentInvariants.CheckLocaleKeyReferences fails a loc key that nothing in the content set names — a key referenced only from C# is an orphan, and an orphan is fatal. This document is that naming. ⚠️ It used to be mostly one sentence saying the shop had nothing in stock; the run-tiles pass of 2026-08-20 (16 D38) built the offer, so the buy and restock captions it deliberately withheld are here and the nothing-stocked sentence is gone. Deliberately absent still: any per-item name, because the perk, consumable and run-buff catalogues already name their own rows, and any price or magnitude, because both are computed from tunables at render time and a number written into a translated sentence cannot be tuned with the number beside it.
